none: PAS NLM-394936: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Burwell
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18; possibly a copy. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTAN[--]AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman, no horse(!). Characters below exergual line but illegible. Reverse inscription: FELTEMP [REPARATIO]. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 1.66gms, die axis: 6
